Package edu.ucsb.cs.citelines.collections

Class CitationFilterState

java.lang.Object
edu.ucsb.cs.citelines.collections.CitationFilterState
public class CitationFilterState extends Object
A MongoDB document storing the last-saved state of a CitationFilter panel (and its open/closed state), keyed by project, which BibTexEntry and direction it belongs to for the two entry-scoped variants (see CitationFilterState.Scope), and which user saved it — per-user, not shared across a project's collaborators, so two researchers filtering the same project's literature search independently don't clobber each other's settings (issue #130; originally shared per-project when first built for issue #121, changed before any real user relied on it).

id is a deterministic composite (see makeId(int, edu.ucsb.cs.citelines.collections.CitationFilterState.Scope, java.lang.String, long)) of the four fields that identify a single user's filter panel scope, so saving the same scope's state twice (i.e. every save after the first) overwrites rather than duplicates it, mirroring UnresolvedCitation.makeId(int, java.lang.String, java.lang.String, java.lang.String, java.lang.String...)/CitationEdge.
